ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Service Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious service installation commands Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ \\-nop\\ .*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ \\-sta\\ .*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ hidden\\ .*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\.downloadfile\\(.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\.downloadstring\\(.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\ADMIN\\$\\\\.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*")))
